h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bettiah

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bettiah

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bettiah

c: Bettiah is the headquarters of West Champaran, the north-western corner of Bihar that runs up to the Nepal border. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bettiah to schools, colleges, district offices, panchayat grounds and residential colonies. Every machine in our Fun Fitness range is built at our factory in Vasai, about 1,440 km away, and reaches you by road.

Distance is the first thing buyers here ask about, so we keep the process short. You send us the size of the ground, a few photos and a rough idea of who will use it. We reply with a list of machines and a layout drawing that marks the clear space each one needs. After you approve the drawing and the quote, we manufacture, dispatch and install, either with our own team or through a dealer who works in eastern India.

richText.heading: A first set for a West Champaran ground

c: The terai monsoon is long here, and many school and panchayat grounds stay damp for weeks after the rain stops. Our frames are galvanised pipe and the seats are roto-moulded plastic, which is why they cope with that kind of season. A sensible first order is the

items.q: Do you send outdoor gym equipment as far as West Champaran?
items.a: Yes. The machines are made at our Vasai factory and sent by road. Our installation team or a dealer covering eastern India fixes them on site and shows your staff the basic checks.

items.q: What should we send you to get a quote?
items.a: The length and width of the area, a few photos of the ground, and whether users will be students, adults or senior citizens. We use this to suggest machines and draw the layout.

items.q: Can the machines stand on a kutcha ground?
items.a: Yes, with grouted installation. Each post is set in a concrete footing, which holds it firm on soft soil. We confirm the method once we have seen photos of your ground.
